Indicators for every cell of a raster

Source: R/grid.R
grid_methods.Rd

The step functions also take a SpatRaster: they then compute, for every cell, what they compute for an extracted location, and return a raster. The raster is read in blocks of rows, so stacks larger than memory can be processed, and each block goes through the same code as extracted data: a cell's numbers are those of the table path at that cell.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'SpatRaster'
calc_threshold_day(
  x,
  above = NULL,
  below = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  period = c("year", "month"),
  min_coverage = 0.8,
  filename = "",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  wopt = list(),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'SpatRaster'
calc_percentile(
  x,
  p,
  exclude_below = NULL,
  exclude_above = NULL,
  yearly = FALSE,
  baseline = NULL,
  replace = NA_real_,
  filename = "",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  wopt = list(),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'SpatRaster'
calc_par(
  x,
  fn,
  period = NULL,
  min_coverage = 0.8,
  prefix = NULL,
  suffix = NULL,
  filename = "",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  wopt = list(),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'SpatRaster'
calc_std_index(
  x,
  scale,
  index = c("spi", "spei"),
  pet = NULL,
  .parallel = FALSE,
  filename = "",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  wopt = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A SpatRaster of daily (or, for calc_std_index(), monthly) data with dates, ideally from read_climate().

above, below, unit, p, exclude_below, exclude_above, yearly, baseline, replace, fn, prefix, suffix, scale, index

As for tables.

period

For calc_threshold_day(): "year" or "month", the periods counted. For calc_par(): as for tables.

min_coverage

Share of a period's days that must have data.

filename

Optional GeoTIFF to write the result to.

overwrite

Overwrite filename when it exists.

wopt

Options for writing, as in terra::writeRaster(), e.g. list(datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE").

...

Not used.

pet

For calc_std_index(): a raster of potential evapotranspiration with the same geometry, for the SPEI.

.parallel

As for tables.

Value

A SpatRaster, one layer per indicator (and period, month or date).

Details

  • calc_threshold_day() counts, per period (year or month), the days beyond each threshold and sums their excess: layers such as day_abv_30_sum_2021.

  • calc_percentile() gives each cell's percentiles by calendar month: layers such as day_90p_07.

  • calc_par() gives each cell's statistics: layers such as tmax_mean.

  • calc_std_index() gives the monthly SPI or SPEI: layers such as spi_3_2021-07.

The result carries its dates, units and the indicator registry in tags that survive writing a GeoTIFF; extract_by_coord() and extract_by_poly() turn the extracted values back into the table the table path gives, with its registry. For spells, percentile-based days and heatwaves on a grid, use grid_indicators().

See also

grid_indicators(), grid_controls()

Examples

tmax <- read_climate(
  system.file("extdata", "tmax_daily.tif", package = "c4e"))
#> Read tmax_daily: tmax [K], daily, 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31, 1095 layers
#> (synthetic).
hot <- calc_threshold_day(convert_unit(tmax, "C"), above = 30)
hot
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 6, 6, 6  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.2, 0.2  (x, y)
#> extent      : 30, 31.2, -1, 0.2  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source(s)   : memory
#> varnames    : tmax (c4e:variable=tmax;source=synthetic;label=tmax_daily;time_step=year)
#>               tmax (c4e:variable=tmax;source=synthetic;label=tmax_daily;time_step=year)
#> names       : day_a~_2021, day_a~_2022, day_a~_2023, C_abv~_2021, C_abv~_2022, C_abv~_2023
#> min values  :          65,          71,          68,  111.852008,  128.858972,  111.859369
#> max values  :         151,         153,         151,  500.295221,  500.155884,  521.408496
#> unit        :        days,        days,        days,           C,           C,           C
#> time (days) : 2021-01-01 to 2023-01-01 (3 steps)
